trials.claimQuote:
- Lifetime access to Invoiless Plan

trials.reasoning: E1 reports support stopping and a broken custom domain, but it does not show that lifetime access itself was revoked or ended.

exhibits.quote: They have stopped giving support after 2 months of this product. The custom domain isn't working.
exhibits.argument: Stopping support after 2 months undermines the value of claimed lifetime access.

trials.claimQuote:
- Unlimited Recurring Invoices
- Unlimited Estimates + Estimates Management

trials.reasoning: E2 asks for recurring invoices to be added as an option, directly suggesting the promised recurring-invoice feature was unavailable to that buyer.

exhibits.quote: 1. Please add more customizable templates. 2. Have the option for recurring invoices.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports recurring invoices still need to be added, contradicting unlimited recurring invoices.

exhibits.quote: so far it has been helpful in generating recurring invoices to my customer without me having to check
exhibits.argument: The quote confirms recurring invoices work as promised by generating them automatically without manual checking.

exhibits.argument: Buyer lost use of a business slot after recreating a company, contradicting 1 code equals 3 businesses.

exhibits.argument: Replacement company could not use the paid code, showing multiple-business management is restricted.

exhibits.quote: The problem started when I used my 3rd code on my 3rd company
exhibits.argument: The quote confirms buyers can use codes across multiple companies, supporting multi-business management.
